title: Table View Number Formatting
author: aprats
content: I have an issue with table view number formatting. On my SQL query, I'm introducing the format: Select FORMAT(Sum(Year_01), 'N2', 'es-es') as Year_01. After populating table view with UseDataTypes=True, it introduces the value as Text.
solution_text: If you use FORMAT in SQL, the column is stored as Text. Solution: Define the text columns as Decimal, then when inserting rows, for number columns, replace ',' for '.' for decimal separator.
